# Griffin Funding

> Griffin Funding is a direct-to-consumer mortgage lender specializing in non-QM loans, bank statement loans, DSCR loans for investors, and VA loans for veterans.

Griffin Funding offers flexible mortgage solutions for self-employed borrowers, real estate investors, and veterans through innovative loan programs that go beyond traditional qualification requirements. The company operates as a direct lender with offices in San Diego and Scottsdale, providing personalized loan origination and competitive rates across multiple product categories.

## Key Topics

- Non-QM Loans
- DSCR Loans
- Bank Statement Loans
- VA Loans
- Self-Employed Mortgages
- Asset-Based Lending

## Core Loan Products

- [Non-QM Loans: Explore Non-Qualified Mortgage Programs](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages): Non-QM loans overview with flexible qualification requirements for alternative borrowers.
- [Bank Statement Loans 2026: Self-Employed Mortgage Guide](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/bank-statement-loans): Bank Statement Loans guide for self-employed borrowers with competitive rates.
- [DSCR Loans 2026: Buy & Refinance Rental Properties](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/dscr-loans): DSCR loans for buying and refinancing rental properties with investment focus.
- [DSCR Loans: Rental Property Investors Guide](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/debt-service-coverage-ratio-investor-loans): DSCR Loans guide for real estate investors based on property rental income.
- [VA Home Loans: Rates & Requirements](https://griffinfunding.com/traditional-mortgages/va-loans): VA loans product page covering rates, requirements, and benefits for veterans.
- [Traditional Mortgage Loans](https://griffinfunding.com/traditional-mortgages): Traditional mortgages including VA, FHA, and Conventional loan options.

## Specialized Financing Solutions

- [Self-Employed Mortgage Loans](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/self-employed-mortgage): Self-employed mortgage options including bank statement and DSCR loans.
- [1099 Mortgage Loans for Self-Employed Borrowers](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/1099-mortgage-loans): 1099 loans for self-employed and gig economy workers without traditional income.
- [P&L Mortgage Loans for Self-Employed Borrowers](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/pl-loans): P&L loans for business owners using profit and loss statements for qualification.
- [Asset-Based Lending: What It Is, Examples, & Rates](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/asset-based-loans): Asset-based lending using liquid assets for home financing qualification.
- [Secured Overnight Finance Rate (SOFR) Loans](https://griffinfunding.com/non-qm-mortgages/6-month-sofr-loans): SOFR loans with adjustable rates for real estate financing and DSCR products.
